+---
+assignees:

+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8480'
+title: Add swift-libgit2 and an internal GitTransport (remote head, shallow fetch, cancel)
+---
+## What
+
+marketplace.md §5.1 (the libgit2 decision) and decision 10. The package must not start the `git` binary.
+
+- `Package.swift`: add `.package(url: "https://github.com/danielctull-forks/swift-libgit2.git", exact: "1.9.7")`, and add `.product(name: "libgit2", package: "swift-libgit2")` to `commonDependencies`. Add a comment on the pin, in the style of the `Yams` pin comment. If `Tests/FoundationModelsSkillsTests/DependencyGraphTests.swift` or `PackageSmokeTests.swift` pins the dependency list, update it.
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsSkills/Marketplace/Git/GitTransport.swift` — `protocol GitTransport: Sendable` (internal) with `func remoteHead(url: String, ref: String) async throws -> String` (40-hex SHA) and `func fetch(url: String, revision: String, intoBareRepository: URL) async throws -> String` (the fetched commit SHA). Add `GitTransportError` (unreachable, refNotFound, cancelled, libgit2(code, message)).
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsSkills/Marketplace/Git/LibGit2Transport.swift` — call `git_libgit2_init` one time. `remoteHead`: `git_remote_create_detached` → `git_remote_connect` (fetch direction) → `git_remote_ls`, and match `refs/heads/<ref>`, `refs/tags/<ref>`, or `HEAD`. `fetch`: `git_repository_init` (bare) if missing → `git_remote_create_anonymous` → `git_remote_fetch` with `git_fetch_options.depth = 1` → resolve the commit. The `transfer_progress` and `sideband_progress` callbacks return non-zero when `Task.isCancelled`, and the call throws `.cancelled`. No built-in timeout.
+- `Tests/FoundationModelsSkillsTests/GitFixtureRepository.swift` — a test helper that makes a repository **with libgit2** (no `git` binary): init, write blobs and trees (file, executable file, symlink), commit, move a branch, add a tag. It gives a `file://` URL.
+
+- [ ] Add the dependency and update any test that pins the dependency list
+- [ ] `GitTransport` protocol and `GitTransportError`
+- [ ] `LibGit2Transport.remoteHead`
+- [ ] `LibGit2Transport.fetch` with depth 1 and cancellation
+- [ ] `GitFixtureRepository` helper
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `swift build` compiles libgit2 from source with zero warnings in this package's own targets
+- [ ] `remoteHead` gives the branch and the tag SHA of a fixture repository over `file://`
+- [ ] `fetch` puts the commit in a bare repository, and a cancelled task throws `.cancelled`
+- [ ] No source file in `Sources/` starts a `git` process
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsSkillsTests/GitTransportTests.swift`: `remoteHead` for a branch, a tag, and a missing ref (`.refNotFound`); `fetch` of the head, then of a newer commit after the fixture moves; an unreachable path (`.unreachable`); a fetch in a cancelled `Task` throws `.cancelled`
+- [ ] Run `swift test --filter GitTransportTests`; then `swift test`; all green and hermetic (no network)
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #marketplace
\ No newline at end of file

Now the siblings resolve at current `main` (Extras d0048eb, MetadataRegistry 48e11e9, Ranker 0015ff2), and the graph holds no Router package.

+    - `ShellInjection.swift` builds a `Process` for `/bin/sh`. The no-git-process guard must not report it, because that line does not name `git`.

Then the retry test and the five `file://` fetch tests failed with `.libgit2(code: -39, "shallow fetch is not supported by the local transport")`. After the retry was added, all tests passed.

Thus an annotated tag gives its commit. Error mapping: GIT_EUSER becomes `.cancelled` and GIT_TIMEOUT becomes `.timedOut` in every phase. Any other connect failure becomes `.unreachable`. GIT_ENOTFOUND while fetching becomes `.refNotFound`. All other failures become `.libgit2(code, message)`.
+    - Additional tests (not on the card): an annotated tag for `remoteHead` and for `fetch`, `HEAD`, a pinned SHA, a missing ref for `fetch`, the retry only for GIT_ENOTSUPPORTED, and the error mapping.
+    - Note: libgit2 runs on the thread of the calling task, because the progress callbacks read `Task.isCancelled`.
